notes: PrefLib file 00019-00000004.toi (dataset 00019, 'oakland'). Counting rule, as far as we know: Instant runoff, single-winner. 108 ballots with two or more candidates tied at one rank were left out (not counted as blank). A 'Write-In' candidate stands for all write-in votes combined.

label_sources.official_winners: Oakland North, "The vote is in: Victory for Kalb, Kaplan, Gallo and Parker" (https://oaklandnorth.net/2012/11/07/the-vote-is-in-victory-for-dan-kalb-rebecca-kaplan-noel-gallo-and-barbara-parker/).
label_sources.max_ranks: Alameda County and San Francisco ranked-choice ballots allowed 3 rankings (every ballot in the file has 3 or fewer ranks).
